_comment: R2: every external artifact the installer or the image builder downloads. sha256 must be filled; CI fails on an empty value. Hosts are matched by suffix.

artifacts.name: bliss-os-16.9.7-gapps-x86_64-iso
artifacts.license: Mixed. AOSP and Bliss components Apache-2.0; bundled Google Mobile Services and libndk_translation are proprietary and are not redistributed by this project.
artifacts.provenance_note: Official Bliss OS 16.9.7 (Android 13) Generic GApps x86_64 build, published 2024-10-11 by Bliss Labs on the SourceForge project blissos-x86 under Official/BlissOS16/Gapps/Generic. Chosen per CLAUDE.md M0 step 1 (generic build, not Go/Surface/Zenith). Includes Google libndk_translation as the ARM native bridge.
artifacts.sha256_verified_note: Computed with sha256sum on 2026-09-25 after downloading from the manifest URL; matched the publisher .iso.sha256 and size_bytes.

artifacts.name: ome-android-15-x86_64-iso
artifacts.license: Mixed open-source: AOSP, BlissOS and Android-x86 components under Apache-2.0, BSD, MIT, GPL-2.0 (kernel, busybox, e2fsprogs, alsa-utils), LGPL and others. Per-project markers are in the release asset NOTICE-guest.md, per-file texts in NOTICE-guest.xml.gz, the kernel source in kernel-source-*.tar.gz. No proprietary file is included (R3).
artifacts.provenance_note: This project's own blob-free Android 15 (API 35) x86_64 image, built on the development PC's WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04) from the BlissOS 18.4 voyager-x86 tree pinned in guest/build/pins.env and guest/build/manifest/ome.xml (manifest commit db973c9), BLISS_BUILD_VARIANT=vanilla with every native-bridge and Google-app flag off (CLAUDE.md R3). Published as the pre-release guest-android-15-20261002 without a build provenance attestation (ADR-0012 item 1); the release carries the build inputs, logs, forbidden-pattern scan and NOTICE-guest.md instead. Split into 1 GiB parts because GitHub caps a release asset at 2 GiB; url is the release page and parts carry the downloads. Evidence: docs/evidence/P3/build-20261002.md.
artifacts.sha256_verified_note: Computed with sha256sum on the build host on 2026-10-02 for the whole ISO and for each part (guest/build/make-release-assets.sh); the three parts concatenated hash to the whole value, and Get-FileHash on the Windows copy matched SHA256SUMS before upload.
